author: /root/resume_arithmetic
claim: Construct the full actual elliptic Kummer homomorphism, prove its exact kernel is doubling including all exceptional points, and inject actual E/2E into the literal squareclass pair.

obligations.name: source_hypotheses
obligations.required_input: The original actual elliptic group over a characteristic-zero field, n nonzero and the two original simple roots.
obligations.constructed_input: Simple derivatives and the actual group-law chord identity are checked explicitly.
obligations.justification: Simple derivatives and the actual group-law chord identity are checked explicitly.

obligations.name: constructed_objects
obligations.required_input: Actual squareclass quotient, full bundled Kummer homomorphism and injective E/2E quotient map.
obligations.constructed_input: No abstract replacement elliptic group or postulated Selmer map is used.
obligations.justification: No abstract replacement elliptic group or postulated Selmer map is used.

obligations.name: index_domain_coverage
obligations.required_input: Every actual elliptic point and every input pair, including infinity, tangent/inverse pairs and all two-torsion points.
obligations.constructed_input: The corrected root coordinates and exceptional halving branches cover the full group.
obligations.justification: The corrected root coordinates and exceptional halving branches cover the full group.

obligations.name: transition_maps
obligations.required_input: Actual chord→value/derivative identities→nonzero square product→quotient homomorphism→exact doubling kernel→quotient injection.
obligations.constructed_input: Both literal coordinates and the same original group law are retained throughout.
obligations.justification: Both literal coordinates and the same original group law are retained throughout.

obligations.name: limiting_object_identity
obligations.required_input: Complete actual Kummer kernel is precisely2E, not a restricted generic-point relation.
obligations.constructed_input: The global Selmer, Cassels-Tate and rank-to-point bridges are not inferred.
obligations.justification: The global Selmer, Cassels-Tate and rank-to-point bridges are not inferred.

obligations.name: coefficient_conventions
obligations.required_input: Roots(-3n,n), exceptional derivatives12n^2 and4n^2, original coordinate order(x+3n,x-n).
obligations.constructed_input: Actual squareclass equality is converted back to explicit nonzero square multipliers.
obligations.justification: Actual squareclass equality is converted back to explicit nonzero square multipliers.

obligations.name: local_conditions
obligations.required_input: Field-generic Kummer construction applicable to Q and its completions.
obligations.constructed_input: No local-to-global point existence is used.
obligations.justification: No local-to-global point existence is used.

obligations.name: exceptional_cases
obligations.required_input: Infinity, inverse pairs, repeated tangent inputs, all root intersections and all exceptional kernel halves.
obligations.constructed_input: A simple-root derivative rules out impossible multiple-root chord cases.
obligations.justification: A simple-root derivative rules out impossible multiple-root chord cases.

obligations.name: downstream_consumption
obligations.required_input: Actual E/2E injection and literal beta-class-to-KummerPoint converter preserving the original point.
obligations.constructed_input: Actual beta-class representation remains the outstanding global input.
obligations.justification: Actual beta-class representation remains the outstanding global input.
